page.overview:
Who is Carlos Miyamoto?

Carlos has long brown hair, blue vest, pants, black armbands and boots. By Street Fighter 6, his brown hair has turned black, being grown long and over his shoulders. He wears sunglasses, a blue leather jacket suit with a red tie and black button shirt underneath, and has red and black fingerless gloves alongside two brown leather belts on his jeans. He also has a leather clipped holder for his katana, which wraps around the front of his suit over his shoulder. He also holds the blade within the holder.

Carlos is brave in nature and has a strong sense of justice, using his katana to strike down evil and believing that Metro City is an area worth protecting. However, he also has a laid-back personality in that he goes to watch wrestling tournaments and wants the Avatar to offer him chili, his favorite food, in his free time. He is also known to be quite knowledgeable about swords and other blades, going into detail about their histories in Street Fighter 6's World Tour Mode.

An old friend who he met after a wrestling tournament in Mexico. Owing a past debt to both Haggar and Guy, Carlos works alongside with him and Maki from within their battle against the Mad Gear Gang in Final Fight 2. After the events of Final Fight 2, he was inspired by Mike Haggar and continued to fight crime.

Carlos grew up in Mexico studying different types of martial arts. He met Mike Haggar at a wrestling tournament where the two of them became fast friends. Shortly after this he moved to Metro City to finish his studies and lived with Mike Haggar for a period of time. Although Carlos had mastered many styles of fighting, he prefers to use his katana to slice and dice his enemies.
